statement: One set the corpus already ships (20453, derived/propagation-twins/twins.tle), written with ephemeris type 4 and with type 0 as TLE and as OMM CSV, JSON, XML and KVN whose values are exactly the TLE's; the TLE's line 1 column 63 and checksum changed, nothing else. MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY = SGP4-XP in one KVN is the corpus's spelling, synthetic: how a provider writes it is not read (the owner's ruling, 2026-11-01). No value is invented (D-409).
